public static intTime\Duration::compare Time\Durationa Time\Durationb
Compares the durations a and b, taking their signs into account. The return value is suitable as the result of a callback for usort.
The same ordering is used by the comparison operators when both operands are Time\Duration objects.

&reftitle.parameters;
a
The first duration.
b
The second duration.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
Returns -1 if a is shorter than b, 1 if a is longer than b, and 0 if both durations are equal. Negative durations are always smaller than positive ones.
